tasks.instruction: Fix the tenant namespace used by GET /v1/session/usage. Session policies may belong to a different tenant than the authenticated user. Both usageSnapshots queries and each returned policy row must use the policy tenant; if its tenantId is omitted or null, use the literal default namespace "default", not the user's session tenant. Keep the public session object tied to the current authenticated user. Changing a user's tenant must not change the policy's usage history, policy budget window, or returned policy rows. Preserve principal-based event visibility, shared totals, exact service-key visibility, policy and provider budget accounting, authentication and privacy boundaries, ordinary explicit-policy-tenant behavior, and zero upstream calls for usage reads. Fix only worker/index.ts. Do not alter ingestion, event ownership, budget scopes, policy normalization, authentication or tests.
